name: gestione-associazioni
description: Sistema di gestione associazioni con plugin system

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: npm run copy:bootstrap && npm run copy:icons
scripts.copy:bootstrap: mkdir -p assets/css && mkdir -p assets/js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css assets/css/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js assets/js/
scripts.copy:icons: mkdir -p assets/fonts && cp -r node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* assets/fonts/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css assets/css/
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run watch

author: Gestione Associazioni Team
